FC Epitsentr Kamianets-Podilskyi is a professional Ukrainian football club from the city of Kamianets-Podilskyi. The club's name \"Epitsentr\" is after the Ukrainian brand of home improvement wholesale stores Epitsentr K. Besides football, the Dunaivtsi club also fields its professional futsal team Verest. They are currently playing in the Ukrainian Premier League. Epitsentr officially moved from Dunaivtsi to Kamianets-Podilskyi in 2024. The club was formed back in 1960 as Kolhospnyk Dunaivtsi, part of the Kolos sports society.
